text: AlUla — the Experience AlUla destination brand behind the team's co-title sponsorship — is run by the Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU), a Saudi government body that Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has chaired since its establishment in 2017.
short: AlUla is run by the Saudi Royal Commission for AlUla, chaired by the crown prince.

source.name: Royal Commission for AlUla (Saudi Government): About RCU — Governance
source.quote: His Royal Highness the Crown Prince has chaired the Board of Directors of RCU since its establishment in July 2017.
source.note: Page header: 'Official government website of the Government of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia'; date from the page's 'Last Modified Date'.
